text:
Maya: Quick prioritization sync — new enterprise asks for tenant-isolated keys + dedicated capacity and wants clear launch gates. Need scope decision.
Priya: Do they insist on HSM day 1 or ok with customer-managed KMS for pilot?
Maya: Sales says HSM preferred later. Pilot can use customer-managed KMS if we provide audit logs and migration path. Target: p95 <= 200ms for 2k-token gen.
Alex: Infra: dedicated pool + KMS connector + audit-log pipeline doable in ~10 business days. HSM vendor work is separate ~3w.
Sam: Runtime: p95 200ms plausible with a tuned model variant + quant + warmed cache; p99 150ms is not realistic now. Need perf matrix.
Jordan: Security: pilot ok on customer KMS but must not claim HSM parity. Will prepare compliance gap doc and required legal wording.
Lee: Product: propose pilot acceptance gates — measurable p95, quality delta <=2% on eval, audit logs available, infra runbook complete. Soft SLA for pilot; HSM and tighter SLOs post-pilot.
Priya: Customer wants pilot in ~8 weeks. If we parallelize tasks across infra/runtime/security, we might make it without HSM. I'll negotiate SOW and a capacity commitment.
Maya: Actions: Alex -> infra runbook & tickets; Sam -> perf runs and eval configs; Jordan -> compliance gap + legal phrasing; Priya -> SOW. Weekly checkpoint next Tue.
Sam: Noted. I'll share initial perf results in 10 business days.
Alex: I'll open the infra ticket and post the link here.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll document decisions in the initiative doc and surface any blockers early.
